# Subramaniam 2018 mFI-5 (modified frail: # Source: Subramaniam S
#         New 5-Factor Modified Frailty Index Using American College of Surgeons
#         NSQIP Data. J Am Coll Surg 2018;226(2):173-181e8.
#         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jamcollsurg.2017.11.005
# SCORE RANGE: 0–5 points. Each binary component contributes 1 point.
#   mFI-5 ≥ 2 = high frailty (paper's clinical cut-point for adverse outcomes).
# THIS FILE IS A SWAP-IN COVARIATE SET (alternate to covariates.csv).
# The integer_risk_score pipeline reads exactly one (covariates.csv
# covariate_concepts.csv) pair via config$covariate_definitions_file and
# config$covariate_concepts_file. To score the mFI-5 against the same cohort:
#   1. Point config to the mFI-5 pair
#      or by renaming files:
#        mv covariates.csv covariates_iannuzzi.csv
#        mv covariate_concepts.csv covariate_concepts_iannuzzi.csv
#        cp covariates_mfi5.csv covariates.csv
#        cp covariate_concepts_mfi5.csv covariate_concepts.csv
#   2. Re-run Step 8.
#   3. Swap back to score Iannuzzi 2020.
# COMPONENT NOTES:
#   fs_dep — Dependent functional status. NSQIP defines as partial or total
#     dependence for ADLs at intake. Operationalised here using the
#     phenotype_library `modified_frailty_index` entry's frailty / impaired
#     mobility concepts (SNOMED 4086506 Frailty + 4306934 Impaired mobility
#     include_descendants = TRUE). The catalog's ambulatory_deficit concepts
#     are intentionally NOT reused here so that the Iannuzzi ambu_deficit
#     score remains a distinct
#   dm — All-cause diabetes mellitus (SNOMED 201820 + descendants). Broader
#     than Iannuzzi's insulin-dependent DM (drug-domain insulin exposure).
#   copd — Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (SNOMED 255573 + descendants).
#     Subramaniam's "COPD or current pneumonia" combined component — current
#     pneumonia is intentionally omitted here: it would require an acute /
#     30-day pneumonia query which is rare in synthetic data and noisy in
#     real-world EHR.
#   chf — Congestive heart failure within 30 days prior to surgery
#     (SNOMED 316139 + descendants). The 30-day lookback follows Subramaniam.
#   htn — Hypertension requiring medication (SNOMED 316866 + descendants).
#     The "requiring medication" qualifier is not enforced here because
#     mapping treated HTN reliably requires drug-exposure linkage that is
#     unreliable in synthetic data; documented limitation.
# COLUMN DEFINITIONS:
#   covariate_id        unique identifier (matches covariate_concepts_mfi5.csv)
#   covariate_name      human-readable label
#   domain              OMOP CDM domain
#   lookback_start_day  days before index (negative) for lookback window start
#   lookback_end_day    days relative to index for lookback window end
#   min_count           qualifying events needed to flag this covariate
#   points              integer score points (1 for every mFI-5 component)
#   missing_is_negative TRUE = absent record → component not present (0 pts)
